_about: Special-event road closures (engine/events.py). The City's feed files an event's closures with its organizer as contractor; 'organizers' names the big ones and says which get the map's banner. Events not listed here still show on the layer, named from their closure text, without a banner unless they have at least 'bannerMin' closures. 'lead' is how many days before an event its banner starts showing.
